chapter_name: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
question_text: Why must you ensure the brake fluid is changed regularly in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's instructions?

options.text: To ensure that the braking system remains functional even under a high load
To ensure that the proportion of water in the brake fluid does not exceed the permitted level
To prevent damage to the components of the braking system

correct_answers.text: To ensure that the braking system remains functional even under a high load
To ensure that the proportion of water in the brake fluid does not exceed the permitted level
To prevent damage to the components of the braking system

comment: You should have the brake fluid changed regularly according to the manufacturer's specifications, because this keeps the brake system functioning properly even under high loads, so that the water content in the brake fluid does not become unacceptably high and so that the components of the brake system are not damaged.

chapter_name: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
question_text: If you do not regularly exchange the air filter, what effects does this have on the engine?

options.text: The percentage of harmful substances in the exhaust gases can increase
Fuel consumption can increase
Engine power can decrease

correct_answers.text: The percentage of harmful substances in the exhaust gases can increase
Fuel consumption can increase
Engine power can decrease

comment: A waiver of the regular air filter changes can increase the proportion of pollutant in the exhaust gases. The power of the engine may decrease and the consumption may increase.

chapter_name: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
question_text: Why should you check the tread of the tyres regularly?

options.text: Because tyres worn on one side can indicate incorrect track or camber alignment
Because irregularly worn tyres can indicate defective shock absorbers or suspension elements
Because irregularly worn tyres can have a negative influence on road behaviour

correct_answers.text: Because tyres worn on one side can indicate incorrect track or camber alignment
Because irregularly worn tyres can indicate defective shock absorbers or suspension elements
Because irregularly worn tyres can have a negative influence on road behaviour

comment: 3 answers are correct. A regular review is necessary because uneven worn tires adversely affect your driving. Because uneven worn tires may indicate defective shock absorbers or suspension means and because unilateral worn tires can indicate wrong track or camber settings.

chapter_name: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
question_text: Why should you check your vehicle before the start of the cold weather period?

options.text: Because the engine's cooling water system can freeze
Because the battery can fail
Because the windscreen washer system can freeze

correct_answers.text: Because the engine's cooling water system can freeze
Because the battery can fail
Because the windscreen washer system can freeze

comment: Because the windshield washer system can freeze and because the battery may fail. In addition, the cooling water system of the engine can freeze up in cold weather. All three answers are correct.

question_text: What preventive maintenance can you carry out on the battery?

options.text: Check that cable connections and battery support are firmly in place
Clean and grease the poles
Exchange battery acid

correct_answers.text: Check that cable connections and battery support are firmly in place
Clean and grease the poles

comment: Check cable connections and battery holder are tight and clean and grease the poles are right. Since acid does not age, it must not be replaced.

question_text: Why is it important to regularly check the engine's coolant?

options.text: A lack of coolant can cause engine damage
A lack of coolant can cause the engine to overheat
A lack of coolant is not important because it is always automatically filled up by the expansion tank

correct_answers.text: A lack of coolant can cause engine damage
A lack of coolant can cause the engine to overheat

comment: A regular check of the cooling liquid is important because it can lead to the absence of an engine failure and the engine could overheat. Please check it from time to time.

To ensure that vehicle parts that are relevant to safety are checked for functionality
To ensure vehicle parts relevant to the environment are checked for functionality

To ensure that vehicle parts that are relevant to safety are checked for functionality
To ensure vehicle parts relevant to the environment are checked for functionality

comment: The inspections provided for you should perform because so environmentally relevant vehicle components are tested for functionality, ensuring that all of the vehicle components are tested for functionality and reaching the wear limits of safety-related vehicle components is detected in time.

Because this allows wear of vehicle parts to be recognized in good time
Because this is to ensure the vehicle is roadworthy

question_text: How are lubricating points lubricated on motor vehicles and trailers?

options.text: In the case of central lubricating systems, from a reservoir
In the case of manual lubrication, using a grease gun on the lubricating points in question
By regularly checking the level of the engine oil

correct_answers.text: In the case of central lubricating systems, from a reservoir
In the case of manual lubrication, using a grease gun on the lubricating points in question

comment: The lubrication points are lubricated with manual lubrication with a hard press on the appropriate lubrication points. In central lubrication systems from a reservoir is also possible and correct.

question_text: What should be noted when lubricating a vehicle?

A noticeable layer of grease should be visible
Old and new grease may not be combined with one another

A noticeable layer of grease should be visible

comment: You should make sure that a noticeable fat entry is to recognize and clean the grease nipples before greasing and cleaning.
